text: You know, you're not so bad when you're not glaring at me.
Careful. I might start liking you.
Same hair, same freckles. Somehow it looks better on you.
Flatterer. Don't stop.
Nora! No, no, no. Get up. Please get up!
Hey! Stay with me! Don't you dare!
Hey, sweetie. Can I talk to you?
Oh, okay. Just get back to me soon, okay?
Thank you. I've been thinking, and from what I've seen of you, you think the same way.
I've come to really enjoy her company, and I think you have too. She's a lot like me in a lot of ways.
But I've seen her change, too. I see a lot of myself in her, but she's becoming her own person. Her choices, her interests, they're different from mine.
I'm still not a fan of asking for a lot of money, but she most definitely is. I think she's a real keeper. What do you think?
I knew it. She'll be glad to hear it.
That's fair. Give her time. She'll earn it.
We need to talk. It's about her.
I know you don't really see her as a person, and I admit I've been having second thoughts myself.
It's odd, seeing my own face, my own body, down to my tattoos, on someone else.
But I don't think she's a simple machine. She's something more. I don't think you should be as dismissive of her as you've been.
Still... she could be on the Institute's side, secretly. What do you think?
Thank you. That's all I wanted to hear.
Me neither, honestly.
...If that's what you really think.
I'm a person! A person!
Remember that night? The three of us, under the streetlight in the park?
Which one of us are you asking?
Both of you.
You know she put a radroach in my bedroll last night.
You put my good boots in the river first.
You're doing good out here, honey. Really good.
We trust you. Both of us. Don't forget that.
Hey, honey. Can we talk to you?
Please, honey. It's important.
Oh, okay. Just get back to us soon, okay?
Thank you.
Anything, huh? Hmm. I can think of a few things.
Same. That's what we want to talk about.
We wanted to talk to you about, well... us.
Yeah. The three of us.
You see, the more we've been traveling, the more... emotions I feel toward both of you.
I feel the same way.
These feelings in my heart for you, my love, have never been stronger. With all we've seen, done, and been a part of.
Most others would have given up. You just kept going, and going. You held your head high and never stopped.
Thanks. But now, there's another thing. Another room in my heart opened. Not just for the two of us, but for three.
Same for me. I still love my husband, and that will never, ever change.
But now I love two people at the same time. I love you too, Nora. And you, my Nate.
I love you both as well. It's just... these emotions, these feelings. I don't know how to take them all in.
Can I love... Nora, and you, at the same time?
Yes, we have. I know, I'm surprised too. But we didn't fall in love with just us.
We fell in love with the three of us. All of us.
Really? Oh, Nate.
Then it's settled. The three of us. Always.
We understand. Really, we do.
We're not going anywhere.
Take your time, honey. We'll be here.
Honey... have you thought any more about us? All three of us?
We'd understand if the answer's still no.
I want to have a lot of kids.
Really? How many?
Ten. Maybe eight.
That many!? Why?
The idea of that many little ones in me, and then running around my feet... it fills my heart with joy.
Dang. I just wanted one, or three more. You have ambition.
Thanks.
When this is all over, I want us to settle down somewhere. A real family. The three of us.
I'd open a law office. Somebody has to bring some law back to the Commonwealth.
And I want to take up hunting.
I don't even know if I can have children. What I am...
Then we'll figure it out together.
I want to find our baby first. Before I can even think about a family again.
I understand. We'll find him.
I found my baby boy, and he's an old man running the Institute. I don't know how to think about new kids after that.
I understand. I just hope you'll think about it.
I think having kids again will take some time. I'm still healing. But when I'm ready... I'd happily have a few.
Me too. A lot of them.
Yes, sir.
Affirmative, sir.
Understood.
As you wish.
Awaiting instructions.
What did you do to her?
Yes! Yes! I love you too. I know I'm not your original love... or am I? Gosh, this synth thing is so confusing.
I will love you no matter what. Let's have the largest family the wasteland has ever seen! I love you so much.
You're doing what? With her? No. No!
Wait... you're marrying her? Why? I'm right here.
Oh, I love this. And I'll help with that large family. Count me in.
